text: Yes, now is fine. What is this product for exactly?
That depends on which product you are looking at. Could you tell me which one interests you today?

The Ashwagandha Capsules cost 699 rupees for 60 capsules. They are an herbal wellness supplement, and for stress or sleep concerns, I would recommend consulting a qualified healthcare professional. Would you like to place an order today?
699 rupees for 60 capsules, okay. But I am already taking blood pressure medicine, so is this safe for me to take? I am a little worried.
I understand your concern. Since you are already taking blood pressure medicine, I would strongly recommend consulting a qualified healthcare professional before starting this supplement.
Haan, I will definitely ask my doctor first. Is it guaranteed to cure stress completely? And are there any side effects?

These products do not cure diseases or guarantee side-effect-free results, so I cannot confirm that. For medical conditions or possible interactions, please consult a qualified healthcare professional.
Arre, no guarantee? Then what is the use? Is there any discount available if I buy it?
There is no discount available right now. Also, these products do not guarantee to cure stress completely and I cannot confirm there are no side effects.
No discount at all? That is too much for 699 rupees then. I will think about it and maybe talk to my doctor before deciding.
I understand, take your time. Just let me know if you would like to place an order later.
